    values = context["values"]
    n = len(values)
    if n == 0:
        return 0

        x = values[i]

        contrib.append(val)
        total = total + x
    for _ in range(3):

        for v in contrib:
            running = running + v
            new_contrib.append(running)
        contrib = new_contrib
    return contrib[-1]
